suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 affects unsafe deserialization in Kotlin Gradle build-cache metadata. The matched org.jetbrains.kotlin artifacts in runtimeClasspath are runtime libraries, not the Gradle plugin or its build cache. CI also disables the Gradle build cache until Kotlin 2.4.20 stable is available. This narrow, expiring suppression prevents the NVD product-level CPE from being applied to non-affected runtime artifacts.
